result.topic_en: Draft notes for Riemann's dissertation: on harmonic functions whose mean value along a circle vanishes, then a definition of a function of a complex variable as a conformal mapping of one surface onto another, with first properties (a function cannot be constant along a line; branch points where dw/dz is 0 or infinity).

items.english: A function of z cannot be constant along a line.

items.english: dw/dz can be zero or infinite only at isolated points.

items.english: Where dw/dz is finite, no folding over of the surface can occur.
